content: Lazarus wulankuda.

Dingkar nyubun burri Lazarus. Nyungu babarr Martha, jinkurr Mary. Nyulu Maryngka juma scent nyangarrin Jesusanda jinanga, kidan mungkabu. Jana townbu Bethany bundandarin. Yala, nyulu Lazarus bambayman.
Bula babarr-jinkurrungku kuku yungan Jesusanda. Kukujingka Jesusanda yalaman, “Maja, yunu jawun bambayman.”

Jesusangka kuku nyajin, nyulu yalaman, “Lazarus bambayman, God jirraymanka. Nyulu bambay, ngayu jirraymanka, ngayu Godumu kangkal. Nyulu kari bambay, wulanka. Kari. Nyulu ngulkurrmal baja. God jirraymal, nyulu ngulkurrmanya.”
Jesus jananka wawu jirray, Marthanka, Marynka, Lazarusanka.
Nyulu kuku nyajin Lazarusanka bambay, nyulu warngku jambul bundan baja.
Jesusangka jawun-karranda 12-balanda yalamanda, “Ngana bubunguku Judeaku dungarida.”
Jana nyungundu yalaman, “Kari, Teacher, ngana jakalbaku yinyaymba dungarin, jana bamangka Jew-warrangka yununin yarkinkaku kuninka kulji yilbanyamundu. Yundu wanyurrimbu yinyaymba dunganka baja?”

Jesusangka jawun-karranda balkanka Jew-warrangka nyungun kariku yarkinkaku kunil. Nyulu juma wulay, nyiku kariku. Yinyaynka nyulu yalaman, “Light wungara. Kaki bama wungara dungay, jana kari daray, nyajijinya. Yinya yala bama ngaykundu mambarriji, jana light wukurrinya. Godungku jananda work dajil bubungu, jana kari wulay, work kunbay-maninka. Kaki bama wujurrbu dungay, jana daray, kari nyajijinya, light yamba-kari.”
Jesusangka yalaman baja, “Lazarus ngananga jawun. Nyulu warngku wunanay. Ngayu dungay, nyungunin walngal.”
Jawun-karrangka yalaman, “Maja, kaki nyulu warngku wunanay, nyulu ngulkurrmal.”
Jana jawun-karrangka nyajil-nyajin balu nyulu warngku-kaja wunananya bambaymun. Yamba Jesus binal nyulu yarkinmankuda.
Jesusangka jananda mumbarabuku balkan, “Lazarus wulankuda.
Ngayu jinbalku kari nyungundu dunganda, yurranka. Ngayu yurranda junjuy milbinka, yurra nganya believeim-bunganka. Yinyaynka ngayu wawurr-wawurrmaniji. Ngana nyungundu dungarida.”
Nyubun jawun burri Thomas Didimus. Nyulu jawun-karranda kanbalba yalaman, “Ngana wubulku nyungunji dungari, nyungunji wularinka.”
Jesusangka juran-bungalarrku.
Jana dungarinda, townbu Bethany kadarin. Yamba Lazarus wulankuda. Warngku 4-balaku jana nyungunin yarkin kuljinga bulkijimunbu nandan.
Town Bethany yubaku townbu Jerusalem, 3 kilometres.
Bama Jew-warra wubul Jerusalemmun kadarin bulanin nyajinka, Martha bulal Mary. Jana bulanji badin bulandamunku yabanka.
Marthangka kuku nyajin Jesus kankadanya. Nyulu bayan bawan, nyungundu maku-jananka. Yamba Mary bayanba bundan.
Marthangka Jesusanda yalaman, “Maja, yundu kadanyaku, ngayku yaba kari wulanyaku.
Yamba ngayu binalda. Kaki yundu Godundu babaji, junjuy-junjuy ngulkurr-bunganka, nyulu yalaku ngulkurr-bungalkuda.”
Jesusangka yalaman, “Yunu yaba juranmal baja.”
Marthangka yalaman, “Nyulu juranmalkuda. Ngayu binal. Bubu kunbay, yarkin-yarkin wubulku juranmal baja. Yaba yalarrku juranmalda.”

Jesusangka yalaman, “Kari. Ngayuku bama juljalmun juran-bungal baja. Ngayuku jananin juranku bunday-manil. Kaki bama ngaykundu mambarriji, jana wuljaljiku juranku bundari. Kaki jana wulay, jananga wawu wangkar-wangkar dakalda, Godunji juranku bundarinka wuljaljiku.
Kaki bama ngaykundu mambarriji, jana ngaykunji bundayarrku, wangkar-wangkar heavenba. Yala yundu nganya believeim-bungal?” nyulu Marthanda babajin.
Marthangka yalaman, “Yuwu, Maja, ngayu yunun believeim-bungalkuda. Ngayu binal, yundu Godundumun. Yundu Godumu kangkalkuda, bubungu kadan wangkar-wangkarmun.”
Jesus banbadin.
Martha dunganda, jinkurr kunjan. Bula bamandamun dungarin, Marthangka Marynda yayngkarabu yalaman, “Teacher kadanda. Nyulu yununin kunjan-kunjal.
Maryngka yinya kuku nyajin, nyulu jinbalku dungan Jesusanda.
Jana Jesus townbu kariku walarin, bundarin yinyaymba Martha nyungundu maku-janan.
Kanbal bama Jew-warra bayanbaku babarr-jinkurrunji banbadin. Jana Mary nyajin jinbalku dunganya, balu nyulu juljalba dunganka, badinka. Jana nyungunin wukurrin.
Mary kadan, Jesus nyajin. Nyulu jakalba Jesusanda bungkubu janan. Nyulu yalaman, “Maja, yundu kadanyaku, ngayku yaba kari wulanyaku.”
Jesusangka nyungunin nyajin banbadinya. Kanbal bama Jew-warra nyungunji kadarin, jana yalarrku banbadirin. Jesusangka yinya nyajin, nyulu jiba-badin jananka, milka-bujarman.
Nyulu babajin, “Nyungunin wanjabu nandan?” Jana yalaman, “Kaday, nyaka.”
Jesus badinda.
Jana bamangka Jew-warrangka yalaman, “Nyaka, nyulu nyungunku wawu jirray bajakukuda.”
Yamba kanbalda yalaman, “Dingkar nyubun miyil kari. Nyulu Jesusangka miyil ngulkurr-bungan. Nyulu wanyurrinku baja bulanga yaba kari ngulkurr-bungan bambaymun?”
Jesusangka Lazarus juran-bungan.
Jesus jiba-badin baja, juljalba dungan. Yinya juljal bulkaji kuljinga. Kulji yalbay bajaku jakalba bulkajimunbu, bulkaji nandanka.
Jesusangka yalaman, “Kulji walnga, jurrki.” Martha, nyulu babarr. Nyulu yalaman, “Kari, Maja. Nyulu kabukuda. Nyulu wungar 4-balaku wulan.”
Jesusangka yalaman, “Ngayu yunundu balkanda. Kaki yundu nganya believeim-bungal, yundu Godumu junkurr jirray nyajil.”
Jana kulji jurrkin. Jesusangka wangkar-wangkar nyajin, yalaman, “Nganjan, ngayu yununin thankim-bunganka yundu ngaykundu milka-jananya.
Ngayu binal yundu wuljaljiku ngaykundu milka-jananya. Yamba ngayu yinyanka balkan bamangka nyajinka, jana binalmanka yundu nganya yungan.”
Wawu praymanijinyamun Jesus yaykarrku yirrkan, “Lazarus, wandida, kadayda.”
Lazarus yarkinmun wandinda, juljalmun kadanda. Mara, jina kajajin mararrda, mararr yindu walungu. Jesusangka jananda yalaman, “Kambi walnga, nyungunin wandi-mana.”
Maja-majangka Jesus yarkinkaku kuninka.
Bama Jew-warra wubul Marynji, jana Jesus nyajin Lazarus yarkinmun juran-bunganya baja. Yinyaynka jana nyungundu mambarrijinda.
Yamba kanbal Pharisee-warranda dungarin, jananda balkan Jesusangka Lazarus juran-bungan.

Yala, jana, Pharisee-warra, maja-maja churchmunku, council-council, jana murumarin, balkawan. Jana Jesusanka wawu kari bajaku. Jana yalaman, “Ngana wanjarrmalda? Nyulu junjuy-junjuy miracle yalbay balkanya junkurr-murubuku, bama wubul nyungundu jurrkin-jurrkiji.

Kaki ngana nyungunin kari kanbil, bama wubulku nyungundu mambarriji. Yinyamun jana bama Rome-warra soldier-soldier kadanji, wubulku buyun-damanji. Jana ngananga bubu, ngananga church yalbay buyun-damanji.”
Dingkar nyubun burri Caiaphas. Nyulu maja jirray churchmunku yalbaynka nyubun yearmunku. Nyulu jananda yalaman, “Yurra binal kari bajaku.
Jarra ngulkurr bama nyubun wulanka bamanka kanbalka. Bama wubul kari wulanyaku.”

Yinya kuku nyungundumun dukulmun kari. Nyulu maja jirray janandamunku churchmunku, Godungku yinya kuku dajin nyungundu, jananda balkanka. Yinyamundu nyulu balkan Jesus wulanka bamanka Jew-warranka wubulkuku.
Nyulu wulay Jew-warrankaku kari, nyulu wulay bamanka wubulkuku yiringkurrku. Nyulu wulay, bama bubungu yindu-yinduymbu nyungu bamamanka, nyubunmanka.
Yinyamun jana maja-maja balkawan Jesus yarkinkaku kuninka.

Jesus kari bububurr Judeamundurr dungan baja, maja-majangka Jew-warrangka nyungun kari nyajinka baja. Nyulu yinyamun dungan townbu Ephraim, yubaku bubungu jirrbu-jirrbungu. Nyulu yinyaymba bundan nyunguwunji jawun-karranji 12-balanji.

Holiday Passover yuba kankadan. Bama wubul bubumun yindu-yindumun dungarin townbu Jerusalem, janaku buyun-buyunmun dayirr-bungajinka Godundumunku lawmunku. Jana yalaku, holiday Passover kadanjiku, jana buyun-buyunmun dayirr-bungajinka Godundumunku lawmunku.
Jana miyil-janjanan Jesusanka. Jana churchmunbu yalbaymba murumarin, balkawan, “Wanjarr? Nyulu Jesus holidaymunku Passovermunku kaday or kari?”

Jana, maja-maja churchmunku yalbaynka, Pharisee-warra, jana Jesus karrbanka, nyungun kuninka. Yinyaynka jana kuku dajin bamanda. Jana bamanda yalaman, “Kaki yurra binal Jesus wanjabu bundanday, yurra must nganjinanda balka, nganjin nyungunin karrbanka.”
